Headed into the Japan Cup, Machikane 
Tannhauser was fully motivated and in peak 
condition. The public was buzzing with 
excitement in anticipation of her 
performance! And then, the day arrived—

Word arrives that she got a nosebleed, 
collapsed, and was rushed to the hospital.

Though it wasn't serious, hearing the 
diagnosis that she couldn't run today, 
Matikane Tannhauser put on a brave face. 
Yet, tears of frustration gradually welled 
up in her eyes.

Amidst it all... her friends arrive to 
offer encouragement. Though she laments 
missing her chance to be the 
"protagonist," they tell her to look 
ahead—that there is always a next time.

These were words she had spoken countless 
times before to inspire others. Having 
bounced back, she sets her sights on the 
Arima Kinen, determined to win it next 
time!
